title: Purely inseparable base changes of a regular formally smooth complete algebra
statement: Let A be a complete regular local domain with fraction field K and C a complete Noetherian local regular A-algebra, with local structure map formally smooth for the maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. For every finite purely inseparable field extension L/K [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], with compatible A-action, L tensor_A C [def-weil-module-base-change] is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PM, proof of (4) => (1), coefficient reduction and final two paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PM

proof.text: Localization base change identifies C tensor_A K with the localization of C at the images of nonzero A. Use localization of a regular ring, and tensor commutativity, to make K tensor_A C regular.

The field K has characteristic zero or prime characteristic. In characteristic zero, pure inseparability plus separability makes K -> L surjective (Mathlib IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable). Tensor the induced A-algebra equivalence with C to transport regularity.

In prime characteristic p, use strong induction on finrank K L. If the bottom intermediate field is top, K -> L is surjective and the previous tensor-equivalence argument applies. Otherwise the final-step consequence of 09HI gives M with finrank K M < finrank K L and finrank M L = p; finiteness and pure inseparability over K are part of its conclusion.

Give M the A-action composed through K. Apply the strong induction hypothesis to M. The degree-p regularity lemma then makes L tensor_A C regular. The induction uses the exact strict finrank inequality furnished by the tower.
